title: Visions of a Flying Scroll and a Woman in a Basket

questions.question: Again I lifted my eyes and saw, and behold, a flying...
questions.explanation: Zechariah 5:1 (ESV): "Again I lifted my eyes and saw, and behold, a flying scroll!"

questions.question: What were the dimensions of the flying scroll?
options: Twenty cubits long and ten cubits wide
Ten cubits long and five cubits wide
Thirty cubits long and ten cubits wide
Forty cubits long and twenty cubits wide
questions.correctAnswer: Twenty cubits long and ten cubits wide
questions.explanation: Zechariah 5:2 (ESV): "It is twenty cubits long and ten cubits wide."

questions.question: Then he said to me, "This is the curse that goes out over the face of the..."
questions.explanation: Zechariah 5:3 (ESV): "Then he said to me, 'This is the curse that goes out over the face of the whole land.'"

questions.question: The scroll was a curse against everyone who steals and everyone who...
questions.explanation: Zechariah 5:3 (ESV): "for everyone who steals shall be cleaned out according to what is on one side, and everyone who swears falsely shall be cleaned out according to what is on the other side."

questions.question: "I will send it out, declares the Lord of hosts, and it shall enter the house of the thief, and the house of him who swears falsely by my name. And it shall..."
options: Remain in his house and consume it
Turn to ashes in his hands
questions.correctAnswer: Remain in his house and consume it
questions.explanation: Zechariah 5:4 (ESV): "And it shall remain in his house and consume it, both timber and stones."

questions.question: Then the angel who talked with me came forward and said to me, "Lift your eyes and see what this is that is going out." And I said, "What is it?" He said, "This is the..."
questions.explanation: Zechariah 5:6 (ESV): "And I said, 'What is it?' He said, 'This is the basket that is going out.'"

questions.question: What did the angel say the basket (ephah) represented?
options: Their iniquity in all the land
questions.correctAnswer: Their iniquity in all the land
questions.explanation: Zechariah 5:6 (ESV): "And he said, 'This is their iniquity in all the land.'"

questions.question: And behold, the leaden cover was lifted, and there was a... sitting in the basket!
questions.explanation: Zechariah 5:7 (ESV): "And behold, the leaden cover was lifted, and there was a woman sitting in the basket!"

questions.question: What did the angel do to the woman in the basket?
options: He thrust her back into the basket
He burned the basket with fire
He struck her with the measuring line
questions.correctAnswer: He thrust her back into the basket
questions.explanation: Zechariah 5:8 (ESV): "And he thrust her back into the basket, and thrust down the leaden weight on its opening."

questions.question: What did the angel place on the opening of the basket after thrusting the woman back inside?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 5:8 (ESV): "and thrust down the leaden weight on its opening."

questions.question: Then I lifted my eyes and saw, and behold, two women coming forward! The wind was in their wings. They had wings like the wings of a...
questions.explanation: Zechariah 5:9 (ESV): "They had wings like the wings of a stork,"

questions.question: What did the two women with wings do to the basket?
options: They lifted it up between earth and heaven
They carried it to the temple
They dropped it into the sea
They smashed it on the ground
questions.correctAnswer: They lifted it up between earth and heaven
questions.explanation: Zechariah 5:9 (ESV): "and they lifted up the basket between earth and heaven."

questions.question: Then I said to the angel who talked with me, "Where are they carrying the basket?" He said to me, "To the land of..."
questions.explanation: Zechariah 5:11 (ESV): "To the land of Shinar, to build a house for it."

questions.question: What was to be built for the basket in the land of Shinar?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 5:11 (ESV): "to build a house for it. And when this is prepared, they will set the basket down there on its base."

key_verse_text: Then he said to me, "This is the curse that goes out over the face of the whole land. For everyone who steals shall be cleaned out according to what is on one side, and everyone who swears falsely shall be cleaned out according to what is on the other side."
